name: Teton River (Driggs)
gaugeName: Teton River ab South Leigh Creek nr Driggs
blurb: Teton Valley meadow water under the Idaho Tetons. Small, technical, and bony by August.

sections.notes: Classic Teton Valley drift. Brushy banks and irrigation — scout new wood every spring.
Gets skinny late. Drift boats more than tubes. Respect private land at the fences.
